newsitem.title: USA: AIG names Tizzio senior vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: AIG names Tizzio senior vice chairman.

text.p: American International Group Inc said president Thomas Tizzio has been named to the new position of senior vice chairman, focusing on the company's worldwide general insurance business.
Evan Greenberg, executive vice president of AIG's foreign general insurance operations, has been named president and chief operating officer of the company, AIG said.

AIG chief executive Maurice Greenberg, speaking at the annual meeting, moved quickly to dispel questions about his own role with the company. "This does not mean I'm changing my role in any way in the company," Greenberg said.
Greenberg, who was 71 when the company filed its proxy statement in April, said he was concerned that the announcement might prompt speculation and rumors about the reason for the executive changes.

But, he said he wanted the changes to be taken at "face value" and that they were simply a move to make the company Nevertheless, the announcement is likely to renew speculation about who will succeed Greenberg as head of the powerful New York-based insurer.
